assets.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Edit the existing CRM/ERP 3D illustration, changing ONLY the content on the monitor screen.
INPUTS: Image 1 is the user's official HARAM logo: a delicate champagne-gold monogram consisting of a tall serif H interwoven with an elegant looping calligraphic R on plain white. Use this supplied logo itself, accurately preserving its proportions, linework, crossing strokes and gold color; do not invent a replacement, add text or typeset H/R separately. Image 2 is the CRM illustration to EDIT. Image 3 is a separate website illustration and must NOT be combined with this output.
Replace the black Korean word 하람 on Image 2's desktop screen with the official gold H/R monogram from Image 1. Remove the Korean lettering entirely. Center the monogram within the ivory screen, with a comfortable generous blank margin, about half the screen height. Composite the logo as naturally flat screen content aligned to the monitor perspective, with clean antialiased edges. Remove the logo reference's white background; the screen must retain its existing warm ivory color uniformly behind and around the monogram, with no white square or sticker edge.
PRESERVE everything else exactly as Image 2: navy monitor silhouette and bezel, periwinkle trim, silver stand, calendar and people pictograms, two wedding rings, all positions, camera perspective, materials, lighting, colors, object scale, square framing and existing transparent background. No device redesign, no added decoration or text. Crisp full-resolution image with genuinely transparent alpha outside the object group. One output containing only the edited CRM illustration.
